sn29.8:1.1: Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā jalābujānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjatīti || || Idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena dvayakārī || So yeva peyyalo || || Ayaṃ kho bhikkhu hetu ayam paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā jalābujānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || ||
